spec.name: M7.FactorReplay.pool_complete
spec.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (p : M7.FactorReplay.BP), p ∈ M7.FactorReplay.pool n ↔ p.natDegree ≤ n
spec.guidance: Unfold actual pool and Finset.mem_image. Forward use Polynomial.ofFn_natDegree_lt (show 1≤n+1 by omega). Backward choose Polynomial.toFn (n+1) p and Polynomial.ofFn_comp_toFn_eq_id_of_natDegree_lt using p.natDegree<n+1. This is complete explicit coefficient-vector enumeration, not assumed finite factor coverage. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M7.FactorReplay.irreducible_check_exact
spec.statement: ∀ p : M7.FactorReplay.BP, M7.FactorReplay.irreducibleCheck p = true ↔ p.Monic ∧ Irreducible p
spec.guidance: Split actual Monic and p=1 guards. In the monic nonone case use Polynomial.Monic.irreducible_iff_lt_natDegree_lt. List.all_eq_true/Finset.mem_toList turns actual finite loop into absence of bounded monic divisors. pool_complete provides every candidate of natDegree≤p.natDegree/2. EuclideanDomain.mod_eq_zero identifies actual remainder=0 with divisibility. No Irreducible decidability oracle occurs in the implementation. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M7.FactorReplay.factor_check_exact
spec.statement: ∀ (F : M7.FactorReplay.BP) (factors : List (M7.FactorReplay.BP × ℕ)), M7.FactorReplay.check F factors = true ↔ (factors.map Prod.fst).Nodup ∧ (∀ t ∈ factors, t.1.Monic ∧ Irreducible t.1 ∧ 0 < t.2) ∧ M7.FactorReplay.product factors = F
spec.guidance: Unfold finite list check; Bool.and_eq_true and List.all_eq_true identify each actual factor check. Rewrite irreducible_check_exact pointwise. Keep positive exponents, distinct factors and exact power product. Empty list accepts exactly F=1. Repeated irreducible multiplicities belong in the positive exponent and are not dropped. This is certificate verification, not a new factor discovery algorithm. Return tactic lines without leading by.
